name: Yaroslav and Divisors
description: Yaroslav has an array p = p 1 , p 2 , ..., p n (1 ≤ p i ≤ n ) , consisting of n distinct integers. Also, he has m queries: Query number i is represented as a pair of integers l i , r i (1 ≤ l i ≤ r i ≤ n ) . The answer to the query l i , r i is the number of pairs of integers q , w ( l i ≤ q , w ≤ r i ) such that p q is the divisor of p w . Help Yaroslav, answer all his queries.
input_specification: The first line contains the integers n and m (1 ≤ n , m ≤ 2·10 5 ) . The second line contains n distinct integers p 1 , p 2 , ..., p n (1 ≤ p i ≤ n ) . The following m lines contain Yaroslav's queries. The i -th line contains integers l i , r i (1 ≤ l i ≤ r i ≤ n ) .
output_specification: Print m integers — the answers to Yaroslav's queries in the order they appear in the input. Please, do not use the %lld specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in C++ . It is preferred to use the cin , cout streams or the %I64d specifier.
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
